caption_L1: Value of fresh or dried hop cones imported to the United Kingdom (UK) from 2001 to 2019 (in 1,000 GBP) is a line chart. The x-axis plots Year. A linear scale from 0 to 50,000 can be found along the y-axis, marked Export value in thousand GBP.
caption_L2L3: The export value rose from less than 10 000 in 2001 to 50 000 in approx 2017. After 2017 it dropped off steeply and then started to go up again.
